sources.title: Distributed control circuits across a brain-and-cord connectome
sources.use: Exact local BANC v888 metadata, two separate detector graphs and supplemental literature roles; all source hashes in audit.json.
sources.limit: Chemical anatomy does not calibrate receptor sign, dynamics, effector force or flight stability.

sources.title: Gap junctions desynchronize a neural circuit to stabilize insect flight
sources.use: DLM motor activity is tonic and far slower than wingbeat; electrical coupling shapes dispersed firing. MN1-4 target ipsilateral fibres, MN5 the contralateral two dorsal fibres.
sources.limit: The BANC chemical-edge exports omit the electrical coupling; per-root muscle force is not given.

sources.title: Role of calcium in the regulation of mechanical power in insect flight
sources.use: Power-muscle neural input modulates calcium and power. Stretch-activated contractions are not one contraction per motor spike.
sources.limit: A measured population relationship does not supply each reconstructed root's calcium/force kinetics.

sources.title: A population of descending neurons that regulate the flight motor of Drosophila
sources.use: DNg02 population activation changes wingbeat amplitude; functional imaging shows visual-motion responses. One DNg07 line reduced amplitude.
sources.limit: No individual BANC DNg02 a-h root has a measured yaw/pitch/roll transfer function from this study. VNC terminals cross the midline, so soma side is not a turning command.

sources.title: State-dependent decoupling of sensory and motor circuits underlies behavioral flexibility in Drosophila
sources.use: DNp07/DNp10 participate in visual landing responses gated by flight state.
sources.limit: They are not generic flight-power commands; landing includes leg movements and behavioral-state dependence.

sources.title: Peripheral anatomy and central connectivity of proprioceptive sensory neurons in the Drosophila wing
sources.publicationStatus: eLife reviewed article RP107867, 2026-03-10; earlier 2025 preprint
sources.use: Maps wing/hinge campaniform, chordotonal and hair-plate structures to central axons; tegula campaniform neurons target b1.
sources.limit: FANC is another animal and ID namespace. Adjacent receptors can have different partners; type or peripheral proximity does not assign a BANC root's phase tuning.

sources.title: A neural connectivity atlas for fly flight control
sources.use: Reconstructs haltere afferent subtypes and their wing-motor pathways. Subtypes can span peripheral fields.
sources.limit: Uses FANC v840, not BANC v888. Putative electrical connections based on membrane apposition must not be inserted into the chemical BANC graph as observed synapses.

sources.title: Flies tune the activity of their multifunctional gyroscope
sources.use: Visual input modulates haltere sensory fields; haltere steering muscles regulate haltere amplitude. Halteres combine body-rotation sensing with active control.
sources.limit: A generic body angular velocity channel is only an engineering surrogate for strain and wing-phase dependent afferent signals.

sources.title: Biomechanical basis of wing and haltere coordination in flies
sources.use: Mechanical thoracic linkages coordinate wings and halteres; clutch engagement permits independent wing control.
sources.limit: Cross-species mechanics support a model class, not calibrated Drosophila per-root actuator coefficients.

sources.title: Whole-body physics simulation of fruit fly locomotion
sources.use: Validated phenomenological fluid-force model and 3-DOF wings support flight; original local XML and task source are hashed in flybody_mechanics.json.
sources.limit: Flight policies combine an engineered wing pattern with trained actions and imitation goals. The policy is not a reconstructed BANC brain; geometry and fluid defaults alone are not a ready validated browser flight engine.

sources.title: NeuroMechFly v2: simulating embodied sensorimotor control in adult Drosophila
sources.access: Existing local FlyGym references and cross-reference in original FlyBody article; direct publisher fetch failed during this pass
sources.limit: This local project has not established an aerodynamic flight controller from NeuroMechFly; do not cite it as proof of autonomous connectome-driven flight.
